$comment: INTENDED syndication state, post x channel. Read by scripts/check-channels.mjs.
This file exists because parity is NOT the expectation. Backfill was cancelled
permanently on 2026-07-30 ('after today, only new articles will be posted to any
account'), so several posts are absent from several channels ON PURPOSE. A checker
that assumed every post belongs on every channel would raise four standing false
alarms forever, and a check that always cries wolf is worse than no check at all --
the next REAL removal would hide in its noise.
present            expect it live now; not finding it FAILS the check
scheduled: <when>  written and queued, not posted to this channel yet. Publishing is
staggered (one post per account per 24h), so a gap between the blog
going live and a channel receiving it is normal. Shows as '>' and
does NOT fail. Flip to 'present' once it is posted.
absent: <reason>   deliberately not going there. The reason is the point -- it is what
stops a future session 'fixing' a gap that was a decision.
WHEN YOU PUBLISH A NEW POST: add its slug here with a cell per channel. The checker
fails on any blog post missing from this file, so it cannot silently rot.

medium.label: Medium
medium.note: Post pages 403 behind Cloudflare for any curl, UA or not. The publication feed is the ONLY reachable check -- served-HTML canonical verification is impossible here.

hashnode.label: Hashnode
hashnode.note: RSS only. Post pages are a JS shell where a real post and a nonsense slug return a byte-identical skeleton, so a page fetch cannot distinguish live from deleted.

bluesky.label: Bluesky
bluesky.note: Matches on the post URL appearing in the skeet text or its embed.

untracked.x: X/@BezaCoreLabs has no public read API without an authenticated bearer token, so it cannot be checked from a public endpoint like the others. Verify by hand during the distill.
untracked.linkedin: LinkedIn personal profile cannot be read without login. Verify by hand during the distill.
